<blockquote>
<p dir="auto"><strong>You never know how much junk your SDK silently injects into your prompts — until you use PrismCat.</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">PrismCat is a <strong>self-hosted, transparent proxy and debugging console for LLM APIs</strong>.
Change one line — your <code>base_url</code> — and instantly see every request and response between your app and OpenAI / Claude / Gemini / Ollama / any LLM API, including streaming (SSE).</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">How It Works</h2><a id="user-content-how-it-works" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: How It Works" href="#how-it-works"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">PrismCat uses <strong>subdomain routing</strong> for truly transparent proxying. When you add an upstream named <code>openai</code>:</p>
<div class="snippet-clipboard-content notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="Your App                     PrismCat                      OpenAI
   │                           │                             │
   │  openai.localhost:8711    │   api.openai.com            │
   │ ─────────────────────────>│ ────────────────────────────>│
   │                           │       logs request ✓         │
   │<─────────────────────────│<────────────────────────────│
   │                           │       logs response ✓        │"><pre class="notranslate"><code>Your App                     PrismCat                      OpenAI
   │                           │                             │
   │  openai.localhost:8711    │   api.openai.com            │
   │ ─────────────────────────>│ ────────────────────────────>│
   │                           │       logs request ✓         │
   │<─────────────────────────│<────────────────────────────│
   │                           │       logs response ✓        │
</code></pre></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Why subdomains?</strong> Because they make the proxy truly transparent — your request paths (like <code>/v1/chat/completions</code>) stay exactly the same. No path rewriting, no SDK quirks. Any language, any SDK, any LLM — as long as it lets you set a <code>base_url</code>, it just works. You can even chain proxies (App → PrismCat → relay → OpenAI) with zero friction.</p>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto"><strong>💡 About <code>*.localhost</code></strong>: Modern browsers and most operating systems automatically resolve <code>*.localhost</code> to <code>127.0.0.1</code> — no hosts file editing required. If your environment doesn't support this, see <a href="#fallback-path-routing-mode">Path Routing Mode</a> or add a hosts entry manually.</p>
</blockquote>

<blockquote>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Always-On, Always Reviewable</h3><a id="user-content-always-on-always-reviewable" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Always-On, Always Reviewable" href="#always-on-always-reviewable"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Built to run as a silent, 24/7 black box — you never have to "remember to start capturing."</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Automatic retention cleanup and large-body offloading keep storage healthy over months</li>
<li>Review what an autonomous Agent actually sent and received, days after the fact</li>
</ul>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Fallback: Path Routing Mode</h2><a id="user-content-fallback-path-routing-mode" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Fallback: Path Routing Mode" href="#fallback-path-routing-mode"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">If your environment can't resolve <code>*.localhost</code>, or you're deploying to a bare IP without a wildcard domain, enable <strong>path routing mode</strong> in Settings to route by URL path instead of subdomain:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="# Path routing mode — no subdomain resolution needed
client = OpenAI(
    base_url="http://localhost:8711/_proxy/openai/v1",  # On a server: http://YOUR_IP:8711/_proxy/openai/v1
    api_key="sk-..."
)"><pre><span class="pl-c"># Path routing mode — no subdomain resolution needed</span>
<span class="pl-s1">client</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">OpenAI</span>(
    <span class="pl-s1">base_url</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"http://localhost:8711/_proxy/openai/v1"</span>,  <span class="pl-c"># On a server: http://YOUR_IP:8711/_proxy/openai/v1</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">api_key</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"sk-..."</span>
)</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Enable via config or environment variable:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-yaml notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="# config.yaml
server:
  enable_path_routing: true
  path_routing_prefix: "/_proxy""><pre><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> config.yaml</span>
<span class="pl-ent">server</span>:
  <span class="pl-ent">enable_path_routing</span>: <span class="pl-c1">true</span>
  <span class="pl-ent">path_routing_prefix</span>: <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>/_proxy<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span></pre></div>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="# or via environment variable
PRISMCAT_ENABLE_PATH_ROUTING=true"><pre><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> or via environment variable</span>
PRISMCAT_ENABLE_PATH_ROUTING=true</pre></div>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Note</strong>: Path routing adds a prefix to your request URL (e.g., <code>/_proxy/openai/...</code>), which may require extra care with how some SDKs construct paths. Subdomain mode doesn't have this caveat.</p>
</blockquote>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Production Deployment (Nginx + Wildcard Domain)</h2><a id="user-content-production-deployment-nginx--wildcard-domain" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Production Deployment (Nginx + Wildcard Domain)" href="#production-deployment-nginx--wildcard-domain"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">For public-facing deployments, use a wildcard domain (e.g., <code>*.prismcat.example.com</code>) with Nginx:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-nginx notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="server {
    listen 80;
    server_name prismcat.example.com *.prismcat.example.com;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8711;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;  # Required: pass original Host for subdomain routing

        # Required for SSE / streaming
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Connection "";
        proxy_buffering off;

        client_max_body_size 50M;
    }
}"><pre><span class="pl-c1">server</span> <span class="pl-c1">{</span>
    <span class="pl-c1">listen</span> <span class="pl-c1">80</span><span class="pl-c1">;</span>
    <span class="pl-c1">server_name</span> prismcat.example.com *.prismcat.example.com<span class="pl-c1">;</span>

    <span class="pl-c1">location</span> / <span class="pl-c1">{</span>
        <span class="pl-c1">proxy_pass</span> <span class="pl-c1">http</span>://<span class="pl-c1">127.0.0.1:8711</span><span class="pl-c1">;</span>
        <span class="pl-c1">proxy_set_header</span> Host <span class="pl-v">$host</span><span class="pl-c1">;</span>  # Required: pass original Host <span class="pl-k">for</span> subdomain routing

<span class="pl-c">        # Required for SSE / streaming</span>
        <span class="pl-c1">proxy_http_version</span> 1.1<span class="pl-c1">;</span>
        <span class="pl-c1">proxy_set_header</span> Connection <span class="pl-s">""</span><span class="pl-c1">;</span>
        <span class="pl-c1">proxy_buffering</span> off<span class="pl-c1">;</span>

        <span class="pl-c1">client_max_body_size</span> <span class="pl-c1">50M</span><span class="pl-c1">;</span>
    <span class="pl-c1">}</span>
<span class="pl-c1">}</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Then add <code>prismcat.example.com</code> to PrismCat's <code>proxy_domains</code>. The dashboard is available at <code>prismcat.example.com</code>, and your upstream <code>openai</code> is available at <code>openai.prismcat.example.com</code>.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Configuration Reference</h2><a id="user-content-configuration-reference" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Configuration Reference" href="#configuration-reference"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The config file lives at <code>data/config.yaml</code> and is created on first launch. Most settings can also be changed from the Settings page in the UI.</p>
<details>
<summary>Full config example</summary>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-yaml notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="server:
  port: 8711
  ui_password: ""           # Console password; leave empty to set it on first UI access
  proxy_domains:            # Base domains for subdomain routing
    - localhost

logging:
  max_request_body: 5242880       # Save request content up to 5MB
  max_response_body: 33554432     # Save response content up to 32MB
  sensitive_headers:              # Headers to auto-mask
    - Authorization
    - api-key
    - x-api-key
  detach_body_over_bytes: 2097152 # Load bodies > 2MB on demand
  body_preview_bytes: 524288      # Inline readable preview; lower for high-frequency long-running use
  early_request_body_snapshot: false

logging_rules:
  # Filled once from the embedded ai_models.json catalog, then fully user-managed.
  model_path_templates_initialized: false
  model_path_templates: []

storage:
  retention_days: 30              # Log retention in days; 0 = keep forever

upstreams:
  openai:
    target: "https://api.openai.com"
    timeout: 120 # Total timeout for the entire upstream request and response

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">FAQ</h2><a id="user-content-faq" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: FAQ" href="#faq"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<details>
<summary><b>Q: <code>openai.localhost</code> doesn't work?</b></summary>
<p dir="auto">Most modern systems resolve <code>*.localhost</code> to <code>127.0.0.1</code> automatically. If yours doesn't:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Add <code>127.0.0.1 openai.localhost</code> to your hosts file</li>
<li>Or enable <a href="#fallback-path-routing-mode">Path Routing Mode</a> as a workaround</li>
<li>Or use your own wildcard domain (see <a href="#production-deployment-nginx--wildcard-domain">Nginx Deployment</a>)</li>
</ol>
</details>
<details>
<summary><b>Q: Streaming feels "stuck"?</b></summary>
<p dir="auto">If you're behind a reverse proxy (e.g., Nginx), make sure you have:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><code>proxy_buffering off;</code></li>
<li><code>proxy_http_version 1.1;</code></li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">Nginx buffers entire responses by default, making streaming look like it's hanging.</p>
</details>
<details>
<summary><b>Q: Which LLM services are supported?</b></summary>
<p dir="auto">PrismCat is a generic HTTP proxy — it's not tied to any specific LLM provider. Any HTTP/HTTPS API works, including:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>OpenAI / Azure OpenAI</li>
<li>Anthropic Claude</li>
<li>Google Gemini</li>
<li>Ollama / LM Studio (local models)</li>
<li>API relay services / aggregators</li>
</ul>
</details>
<details>
<summary><b>Q: Does it add latency?</b></summary>
<p dir="auto">PrismCat uses asynchronous log writing. The proxy overhead is typically under 1ms. Logging never blocks request forwarding.</p>
</details>
